articles.author: Anusuya Lahiri
articles.headline: What's Going on With Intel Stock Wednesday?
articles.summary: INTC falls 2% premarket on profit-taking. Despite the dip, technicals stay bullish ahead of July 23 earnings.
articles._summary: Nasdaq futures were down 0.54%, while S&P 500 futures slipped 0.31%, weighing on technology stocks ahead of the opening bell. Intel appeared to be facing profit-taking after a strong rally that pushed the stock close to its 52-week high. The stock has significantly outperformed the broader market over the past year. That leaves it vulnerable to short-term selling when investor sentiment weakens.
articles._zh_headline: 英特尔股票周三怎么样？
articles._zh_summary: 纳斯达克期货下跌 0.54%，标准普尔 500 指数期货下跌 0.31%，在开盘前打压科技股。英特尔股价强劲上涨并接近 52 周高点后，似乎面临获利了结。过去一年，该股的表现明显优于大盘。这使得当投资者情绪走弱时，它很容易受到短期抛售的影响。

articles.author: Rishabh Mishra
articles.headline: Apple CEO Tim Cook Flags 'Extreme Shortage' While DRAM ETF Smashes $25 Billion, Surging Over 170% Since Listing
articles.summary: Apple CEO Tim Cook flags an "extreme shortage" in memory chips while the $DRAM ETF shatters records, hitting $25B in just 84 days.
articles._summary: The AI revolution is driving unexpected inflation in the hardware sector, with demand vastly outstripping supply. Apple CEO Tim Cook characterized the current market dynamics as a “100-year flood,” noting he has “never seen anything like it in any area in over 40 years.” While hyperscalers bear the brunt of these costs, semiconductor and memory companies are capturing historic “windfall profits.” This immense wealth transfer is perfectly illustrated by the unprecedented rise of the DRAM ETF.
articles._zh_headline: 苹果首席执行官蒂姆·库克表示“极度短缺”，而 DRAM ETF 暴跌 250 亿美元，自上市以来飙升超过 170%
articles._zh_summary: 人工智能革命正在推动硬件行业出现意想不到的通货膨胀，需求远远超过供应。苹果公司首席执行官蒂姆·库克将当前的市场动态描述为“100年一遇的洪水”，并指出他“40多年来从未在任何领域见过类似的情况”。虽然超大规模企业首当其冲地承受着这些成本，但半导体和内存公司正在获得历史性的“意外利润”。 DRAM ETF的空前崛起完美地说明了这种巨大的财富转移。

articles.author: Tanya Rawat
articles.headline: Fed's Beth Hammack Warns AI Spending Could Keep Inflation Hot and Force Interest Rates Higher: 'Not Seeing A Lot Of Restraint...'
articles.summary: AI infrastructure demand may fuel inflation and force higher rates, Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack warns.
articles._summary: Cleveland Federal Reserve President Beth Hammack said Tuesday that surging demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure could add to inflationary pressures and may force the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates again if price growth remains elevated. Speaking to CNBC from the European Central Bank conference in Sintra, Portugal, Hammack said inflation remains above the Fed’s 2% target and warned that persistent price pressures tied to AI spending could complicate monetary policy.
articles._zh_headline: 美联储贝丝·哈马克（Beth Hammack）警告人工智能支出可能会导致通胀持续升温并迫使利率走高：“没有看到太多限制……”
articles._zh_summary: 克利夫兰联储主席贝丝·哈马克周二表示，对人工智能基础设施的需求激增可能会增加通胀压力，如果物价增长持续走高，可能迫使美联储再次加息。哈马克在葡萄牙辛特拉举行的欧洲央行会议上接受 CNBC 采访时表示，通胀率仍高于美联储 2% 的目标，并警告称，与人工智能支出相关的持续价格压力可能会使货币政策复杂化。

articles.headline: Stock Market: Will S&P 500 Open Up Or Down Today?
articles.summary: July 1, 2026: Polymarket traders expect a weaker S&P 500 open on the first trading day of the month after June capped strong quarterly and first-half gains.
articles._summary: The S&P 500 ended June on a strong note, capping off its best quarter since 2020, but Polymarket traders are betting the benchmark index could start the second half of the year on a weaker footing. The S&P 500 gained 0.79% to close at 7,499.36 on Tuesday. However, the July 1 Polymarket contract implies just a 27% probability that the index will open higher on Wednesday.

articles._zh_summary: 标准普尔 500 指数 6 月份表现强劲，结束了 2020 年以来最好的季度，但 Polymarket 交易员押注该基准指数可能会在今年下半年开始表现疲软。标准普尔 500 指数周二上涨 0.79%，收于 7,499.36 点。然而，7 月 1 日的 Polymarket 合约意味着该指数周三开盘走高的可能性仅为 27%。

articles.headline: Jim Cramer Says Wall Street Is Rewarding AI Makers While 'Punishing' Their Biggest Customers
articles.summary: Jim Cramer said Wall Street is rewarding AI infrastructure suppliers while punishing Big Tech companies spending to build it.
articles._summary: Jim Cramer said Tuesday that Wall Street is increasingly rewarding companies supplying artificial intelligence infrastructure while punishing the technology giants spending heavily to build it. Speaking on CNBC’s Mad Money show , Cramer said investors are favoring chipmakers, memory companies and networking suppliers over hyperscalers committing hundreds of billions of dollars to AI infrastructure.

articles.headline: Trump made more than $1bn from crypto in first year back in office
articles.summary: The president's crypto income far outpaces his earnings from real estate and Trump-themed items such as watches.
articles._summary: US President Donald Trump has been involved in business dealings. US President Donald Trump made more than $1bn (Â£750m) last year from business dealings in cryptocurrency, according to his mandatory financial report for 2025. In a 927-page disclosure, he reported $635m in royalties from a Trump meme coin that has plunged in value since he launched it days before taking office. He also reported over $500m in income from World Liberty Financial, a cryptocurrency firm founded by his own sons and the children of his special envoy, Steve Witkoff. He earned millions more from real estate and Trump-themed items. But the White House denied he was profiting from the presidency. The earnings from his latest financial disclosure far outpace the previous ones for 2024, when Trump disclosed over $600m of income. But the White House, which has repeatedly emphasised that Trump has placed his businesses in a trust managed by his sons, again denied any conflict of interest.
articles._zh_headline: 特朗普上任第一年就从加密货币中赚取了超过 10 亿美元
articles._zh_summary: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普一直参与商业交易。根据美国总统唐纳德·特朗普 2025 年的强制性财务报告，他去年从加密货币商业交易中赚取了超过 10 亿美元（7.5 亿英镑）。在一份长达 927 页的披露中，他报告了特朗普模因币的特许权使用费为 6.35 亿美元，自从他上任前几天推出该币以来，该币的价值已经暴跌。他还报告了世界自由金融公司 (World Liberty Financial) 的收入超过 5 亿美元，这是一家由他自己的儿子和他的特使史蒂夫·威特科夫 (Steve Witkoff) 的孩子创立的加密货币公司。他从房地产和特朗普主题物品中赚取了数百万美元。但白宫否认他从总统职位中获利。特朗普最新披露的 2024 年财务报告显示的收入远远超过之前披露的超过 6 亿美元的收入。但白宫一再强调特朗普已将其企业交给其儿子管理的信托公司，再次否认存在任何利益冲突。

articles._summary: Corgi , an AI-focused fintech startup, has launched and listed 31 single-stock 2x Daily ETFs across two rollout phases on June 24 and June 26, significantly expanding its leveraged ETF lineup. • Bloom Energy Stock Rallies After The Bell — Here’s Why The funds are designed to deliver two times (2x) the daily performance of a single underlying stock, targeting active traders seeking amplified short-term exposure.

articles.author: Radhika Anilkumar Nadig
articles.headline: Why Are Central Banks Buying So Much Gold? 90% Institutions Cite This Reason
articles.summary: Central banks are turning to gold for protection against crises, inflation and geopolitical risks, according to the World Gold Council survey.
articles._summary: Central banks are increasingly turning to gold as protection against financial crises, inflation and geopolitical risks, according to a World Gold Council survey highlighted Tuesday by market commentator, The Kobeissi Letter . According to the survey of 69 central banks, 90% of respondents cited gold’s performance during periods of crisis as a primary reason for holding on to the precious metal.
articles._zh_headline: 为什么央行购买如此多的黄金？ 90% 的机构都引用这个理由
articles._zh_summary: 市场评论员《Kobeissi Letter》周二强调的世界黄金协会调查显示，各国央行越来越多地转向黄金作为抵御金融危机、通胀和地缘政治风险的手段。根据对 69 家央行的调查，90% 的受访者将黄金在危机时期的表现视为持有贵金属的主要原因。
